import sys

MAX = 31
MOD = 10**9 + 7

n = 0
mat = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self):
        self.t = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    def init(self):
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                self.t[i][j] = 1 if i == j else 0
    def mul(self, b):
        global mat
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                mat[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    mat[i][k] += self.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                self.t[i][j] = mat[i][j] % MOD

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    m_in = int(input_line[0])
    k_in = int(input_line[1])
    m_value = m_in
    k_value = k_in
    digits = []
    while m_value:
        digits.append(m_value % k_value)
        m_value //= k_value
    global n
    n = k_value + 1

    base = Matrix()
    identity = Matrix()
    for i in range(k_value):
        base.t[i][(i+1) % k_value] = 1
    base.t[k_value][k_value] = 1
    identity.init()
    for i in range(k_value + 1):
        base.t[0][i] = 1
        base.t[i][i] = 1

    d = [Matrix() for _ in range(len(digits))]
    d[0] = identity
    d[0].mul(base)
    for i in range(1, len(digits)):
        d[i] = d[i-1]
        for _ in range(k_value):
            d[i].mul(d[i])
        d[i].mul(base)

    ans = [1] * n
    powArr = [0] * n
    for idx in range(len(digits)-1, -1, -1):
        for _ in range(digits[idx]):
            for i in range(n):
                powArr[i] = 0
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    powArr[j] += ans[i] * d[idx].t[i][j]
            for i in range(n):
                ans[i] = powArr[i] % MOD
    print(ans[k_value])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
